families.name: Bollinger Bands
provenance_notes: candidate thresholds include train-derived and diagnostic-derived evidence; diagnostic-derived thresholds cannot count as independent promotion proof
known_negative_findings: same-entry-bar state is non-causal
completed 15m above-mid did not improve candidate
completed 15m position >=0.75 reduced candidate PF
tight retest timing not justified
extra OR/ATR threshold not stable enough

families.name: Causal Fibonacci Retracement
provenance_notes: public ideas are architecture/hypothesis donors only
no hindsight swing picking
confirmed-breakout descriptive evidence uses frozen V11.2 trade evidence and audited 2014-2019 data
known_negative_findings: OR-completed session-open to directional OR-extreme produced 0/667 fixed-zone retracement observations and mainly measured extension
confirmed-breakout impulse has limited coverage: 213/856 eligible observations and 45 fixed-zone observations
descriptive zone P/L is not valid for zone selection or promotion

families.name: Opening Gap
provenance_notes: opening gap remains separate from intraday fair-value-gap concepts
856/856 reproduced normal-cost OOS trades received prior-close to 09:00-open gap context
full-sample gap quantiles are OOS diagnostic only and cannot become selector thresholds
known_negative_findings: simple gap-direction agreement with frozen trade side was not useful: aligned 396 trades -14.0755R PF 0.9424 vs opposed 460 trades -17.2337R PF 0.9365
calendar-year gap-direction effects were inconsistent and do not support a standalone selector

families.name: Failure Taxonomy
provenance_notes: literature and failure observations create tests/gates, never direct trading rules

families.name: Bounded Research Sleeve
provenance_notes: no martingale, revenge sizing, borrowing or loss-triggered size escalation

families.name: ATR / OR-ATR Regime
provenance_notes: legacy OR/ATR thresholds remain LEGACY_OBSERVATION only
ATR14 uses completed M5 candles strictly before entry
public regime projects are hypothesis/architecture donors only
856/856 reproduced normal-cost OOS trades received causal ATR/OR-ATR features
81 canonical WFs used train-only OR5/OR15 tertile boundaries frozen before OOS application
result classification is OOS_DIAGNOSTIC_DERIVED, not independent promotion proof
known_negative_findings: ATR HIGH was superficially positive in aggregate (+7.3244R on 340 trades) but unstable: 68 active WFs split 34 positive/34 negative with near-zero median R per active WF
ATR HIGH decayed from +17.1591R in WF1-27 to -1.7911R in WF28-54 and -8.0436R in WF55-81
OR/ATR train-only tertiles were unstable across WF eras and do not support a standalone selector

families.name: Liquidity Sweep
provenance_notes: reference levels are emitted only after confirmation
raw M5 bar-open timestamps are shifted +5 minutes before LIQ001 use
856-trade descriptive run had 0 sweep state-time violations
181 trades had a confirmed wick-rejection sweep before entry
public market-structure projects are architecture/testing donors only
known_negative_findings: same-confirmation-bar sweep is invalid
centered swing windows are lookahead-biased if backdated
aggregate sweep weakness is heavily confounded with SESSION001
within EARLY session sweep presence was approximately neutral and no selector is retained

families.name: Market Structure
provenance_notes: reuses LIQ001 confirmed-level primitive as the single research swing-timing source
raw M5 bar-open timestamps are shifted +5 minutes before structure use
856-trade descriptive run had 0 BOS state-time violations
171 trades had at least one confirmed BOS before entry
known_negative_findings: pivot timestamp is not a valid state time when future-side confirmation bars are required
same-confirmation-bar BOS is invalid
aggregate BOS weakness is heavily confounded with session age
EARLY-BOS diagnostic failed era stability and is not retained

families.name: Momentum
provenance_notes: fixed pilot uses only completed-bar return_1, return_3, directional_closes_3, body_fraction and range_points
MomentumBar.time is completion/availability time and must be strictly before entry_time
frozen trade timestamps were correctly localized as Europe/Berlin wall-clock before UTC market-data alignment
856/856 trades received causal momentum features with 0 state-time violations
public momentum repositories are architecture/testing donors only; GPL donor code is not copied
known_negative_findings: same-entry-time candle information is non-causal
OOS-derived momentum cutoffs cannot count as independent promotion proof
directional_closes_3=+3 was superficially positive but unstable across years/WF eras and is not retained
simple ret3 direction agreement did not improve the frozen V11.2 ledger

families.name: Session / Time Context
provenance_notes: uses Europe/Berlin timezone with DST-aware conversion
coarse EARLY/MIDDLE/LATE phases are fixed before outcome inspection
corrected descriptive run placed all 856 trades inside the Berlin session
no minute-level optimization or event-calendar assumptions
known_negative_findings: minute-by-minute bucket search is prohibited
weekday/context observations cannot be promoted without fresh predeclared validation
MIDDLE weakness is OOS diagnostic only despite broad negative stability and cannot be added to V11.2 without fresh/prospective evidence

families.name: Entry Diagnostics
provenance_notes: describes frozen V11.2 signal/retest-to-entry timing and risk/target geometry only
must not alter entry_time, price, signal choice or frozen execution semantics
future signal/retest timestamps fail closed
856-trade descriptive run confirmed median signal-to-entry of 5 minutes and invariant retest-to-entry of 5 minutes
known_negative_findings: descriptive entry timing cannot be converted into a selector from the same OOS evidence
the exact 5-minute retest-to-entry lag is a frozen execution property, not evidence for a new timing filter

families.name: Exit Diagnostics
provenance_notes: MFE/MAE and capture metrics are post-trade diagnostics only
post-trade fields are structurally forbidden from pre-entry decision logic
invalid MFE/MAE sign conventions fail closed
856-trade post-trade descriptive run recorded holding time, MFE/MAE and exit-reason diagnostics
known_negative_findings: MFE/MAE-derived exit rules require a fresh predeclared hypothesis and independent validation
substantial favorable excursion before some stop/session-close exits is hypothesis-generating only and does not validate a trailing rule
